# Is anything in your node_modules GPL?

> Paste your package-lock.json and see every dependency licence: copyleft (GPL, AGPL), unlicensed and unknown packages flagged first. Free npm license checker, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/lockfile-license-check/)
- [An npm licence compliance checklist for shipping software](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/lockfile-license-check/npm-license-compliance-guide.html)
